The '''Intelligence Center''' was a data analysis center aboard the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']]. The Center was commanded by [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] and was guarded around the clock.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
